contributions.anchor: Form A's own printed 'Total Contributions: (to line 1 of report)' = 5,000.00, which equals the cover's 'Totals for This Report' line-1 cell (5,000.00)
contributions.detail: The single Form A row (Utah Forward PAC, 5,000.00) sums to 5,000.00 = the schedule's printed total = the cover's This-Report cell. The cover's CUMULATIVE line-1 cell is 13,895.18 because 8,895.18 was carried in the 'Totals from Last Report' column from Froerer's earlier 2022 report; the 13,895.18 - 5,000.00 = 8,895.18 residual is prior-period money this schedule does not itemize. 2022 form is the 3-line variant, so there is no separate <=$50 aggregate cell and contrib_all is the anchor.

expenditures.anchor: Form B's own printed 'Total Expenditures: (to line 2 of report)' = 9,624.58, which equals BOTH the cover's This-Report and its Cumulative line-2 cells (9,624.58)
expenditures.detail: 6 Form B rows: 1,000.00 + 500.00 + 1,215.00 + 3,254.58 + 66.00 + 3,589.00 = 9,624.58, to the cent. The cover's line-2 'Totals from Last Report' cell is a bare dash (the filer restarted the expenditure count at this report), so this-report and cumulative are the same figure and the side is exact rather than period-exact.

escalation_note: 900 dpi --value crops on p38 (row-1 date cell and row-1 amount cell) to prove the extrapolated row grid on a rotated sheet whose vertical rules the default detector under-reports; 500-700 dpi --value crops on p39 for the amount-column band and for the p39 row-4 / row-6 name cells ('Weber County Jr. Livestock Donation' and the one-word vendor 'Arena', both confirmed verbatim). No amount was in doubt; every escalation was legibility/geometry, and the printed schedule totals gated both sides.

38.measure_note: Form A is bound ROTATED (landscape): the printed column separators are the page's HORIZONTAL rules and the table's row separators are its VERTICAL rules, so axis='x' and rows advance RIGHT-TO-LEFT across the rendered page (row 1 is the rightmost data band, next to the header strip). Column bands from a horizontal-rule projection taken over the blank x-window 15-40% (5 rules: 4.89/13.02/43.25/85.34/95.98 = Date | Name of Contributor | Address | Amount). Row bands from a vertical-rule projection at coverage 0.35 over the table's y-extent, which returns 27 rules on a regular 3.06-3.17 pct pitch (the default 0.60 threshold returns only 1 on this sheet); the two rules right of the row grid bound the shaded scan-fold strip and the printed header strip, which are NOT data rows. PROVED with two 900 dpi --value crops at the intersection of band 1 with the Date column (reproduces '7/5/2022') and with the Amount column (reproduces '5,000.00').

39.measure_note: Same rotated-landscape geometry as p38. Column bands from the horizontal-rule projection over the blank x-window 15-40% (6 rules: 3.50/11.64/57.05/67.73/86.50/97.16 = Date of Expenditure | Person or Organization | City | Purpose of Expenditure | Amount). Row bands from the vertical-rule projection at coverage 0.40 (27 rules, pitch ~3.06); the rules at 83.97/88.94/91.44 bound the shaded fold strip and the header strip and are not data rows. PROVED with a 500 dpi --value crop spanning x 74.65-91.65 x y 82-99, which reproduces the 'Amount' header in the header strip and 1,000.00 / 500.00 inside bands 1 and 2 respectively.

notes: Typed 2022 Weber 3-line cover (p37) + FORM A on p38 + FORM B on p39, both bound rotated 90 degrees. The cover's 'October 25 - Nov 1' box is marked 'X X'. No page on this filing prints a per-page SUBTOTAL - each schedule prints one grand total at its foot, and that is the gate used. No in-kind row and no negative/parenthesised amount on either schedule. Candidate and committee-secretary addresses/phones print on the cover face and are not carried (PRIVACY.md).
